header: Our team at the 30th anniversary, June 2024
lead: Taken in the yard behind the Bahnhofstraße office, an hour before the anniversary lunch. It started raining 20 minutes later.
caption: The Aubruck team, June 2024. Six people are missing: four were on site and two had the day off.
note: Back row, left to right: Tobias Reindl, Emre Aydin, Paul Ebner, Hanno Grasser, Roland Lachner, Norbert Pichlmayr, Milan Hrdlicka. Middle row: Christoph Waldner, Sabine Wolkersdorfer, Clara Hofstätter, Renate Söllner, Firat Yildiz, Nadja Reithofer. Front row: Anja Feuerstein, Katja Sunder, Lea Wimmer, Gerhard Tulln, Helene Marchetti, Andrea Brandstätter, Doris Achleitner.

image.alternative: Twenty colleagues stand in three rows in a paved yard behind the office on an overcast day.
